brief:
Israel's Central Elections Committee rejected a request by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party to extend voting hours beyond 10 p.m. local time, Middle East Eye reported. The committee made the decision on Tuesday, denying the Likud party's bid to keep polls open longer.

Details on Netanyahu's reasoning for the extension request were not immediately available. The vote proceeded under standard closing time procedures.
dek: Israel election commission rejects Netanyahu party bid to extend voting Israel's Central Elections Committee on Tuesday rejected a request by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party to extend voting beyond 10pm local time.
title: Israel election commission blocks Netanyahu party voting extension bid
